notes_for_editor: Record agency field holds the legal location 144N-36W-34; a correction is proposed. The sources disagree on the range: the Forest Lookouts page gives 144N-36W-34, while the A-Z list gives '34 144 39' (range 39). Not resolved; the story uses neither. Record ownership is 'unknown'; the 1964 station note (state property) and the county owner code (Mn MFS) suggest state ownership of the tower, but this is an addition rather than an error, so it is not proposed as a correction. No build date and no staffing history appear in any source read. The 1964 date is the survey date; the year of abandonment is not stated, so the 1964 event is typed 'other' rather than 'abandoned'. The 1964 station description says the station is near the site of an abandoned tower, not on it. The Twin Lakes alias is confirmed by the county list ('Also called Twin Lakes Lookout Tower') and the A-Z list (which says it is another name for the Bass Lake tower near Naytahwaush). Record lat/long matches the county list within rounding. Confidence is medium because the status and alias rest on a small number of short entries.
